formalCitations.exactSourceText: 裕 describes plenty or roominess, including material prosperity. 裕福 (ゆうふく) means well-off, 富裕 (ふゆう) means wealthy, and 余裕 (よゆう) means spare capacity or leeway.

**Modern-shape mnemonic, not etymology:** imagine 谷 to the right of 衤 as an open space with room to spare. This memory aid follows the present left-right outline, not the character's historical formation.

title: wide, spacious

広 concerns width, space or spreading. [広い](../words/広い.md) describes something spacious or wide; related verbs describe spreading something or its becoming widespread.

**Modern-shape mnemonic:** picture the 广 shelter with only a small ム-shaped bundle inside, leaving plenty of space. This is a modern visual mnemonic, not an origin claim.

title: surplus

余 concerns what is left beyond what is used or needed.
[余る](../words/余る.md) あまる describes something being left over; 余分 よぶん describes an extra or surplus amount.
The surplus can be helpful, such as spare time, rather than necessarily a problem.

[余](../kanji/余.md) contributes what remains or is in excess. [裕](../kanji/裕.md) contributes plenty or roominess. Together they express having more capacity than the immediate demand consumes. The on readings are ヨ + ユウ.

comparisons.reason: Possible fortune/prosperity overlap via the whole word 裕福 and English "fortune"
comparisons.disposition: Harmless: 福's card describes favorable fortune, blessing, happiness and welfare, not wealth or plenty (repo/kanji/福.md:20-22); 裕 is abundance with room to spare (evidence/external-snapshots/01-extract.txt:7); 裕福 is a whole word. Not declared on either endpoint; none needed.

comparisons.reason: Surplus/left-over versus plenty/room to spare; both in 余裕
comparisons.disposition: Harmless, medium confidence: 余 is what is left beyond use or need (repo/kanji/余.md:20-22) and KANJIDIC2 gives 裕 only abundant, rich, fertile (evidence/kanjidic2-records.xml:52-54); 余裕's "surplus" gloss is whole-word. Not declared on either endpoint; see O1.

Harmless: 満's card teaches fullness, occupancy and satisfaction (repo/kanji/満.md:20-22); no opened source gives 裕 a full or satisfy sense (evidence/kanjidic2-records.xml:52-54). Not declared; none needed.

comparisons.reason: 栄's body includes prosperity, close to well-off
comparisons.disposition: Harmless, medium confidence: 栄 concerns flourishing, prosperity or glory as a process or splendour (repo/kanji/栄.md:20); 裕 is a state of plenty with leeway (evidence/external-snapshots/01-extract.txt:7), and neither "flourish" nor "glory" is an attested 裕 sense. Not declared; none needed.

Harmless: 資 is resources supporting an activity, funds or materials (repo/kanji/資.md:20-22), a noun of supply, not abundance or being rich (evidence/kanjidic2-records.xml:52-54). Not declared; none needed.
Harmless: 宝 names treasure objects (repo/kanji/宝.md:20); 裕 has no treasure/valuables sense in KANJIDIC2 or Daijisen (evidence/kanjidic2-records.xml:52-54). Not declared; none needed.

comparisons.reason: Spaciousness versus the card's roominess/open-space teaching
comparisons.disposition: Collision needing exclusion: the 裕 card teaches "plenty or roominess" and an "open space with room to spare" image (snapshot/kanji/裕.md:23-25); Weblio Wiktionary records out-of-table kun ひろ-い for 裕 (evidence/external-snapshots/01-extract.txt:49); 広 means width or available space (repo/kanji/広.md:20-22). Declared on neither endpoint; see F1.

Harmless with qualification: 多 concerns number/quantity, "lots" (repo/kanji/多.md:20); 裕's sources give abundance with leeway and wealth, not count (evidence/external-snapshots/01-extract.txt:7). The overlap comes from the English word "abundant" in 裕's title; not declared; see O2.

comparisons.reason: 優に amply, with irregular spelling 裕に
comparisons.disposition: Harmless: 優's title and body cover kindness and excellence (repo/kanji/優.md:20-22); 裕に is marked irregular kanji usage (evidence/jmdict-families.xml:1761-1763) and the 裕 card already warns against it. Not declared; none needed.

Harmless, medium confidence: 濃 is concentration, density, intensity (repo/kanji/濃.md:20); 裕's "rich" sits beside "abundant; fertile" and means wealthy/plentiful (evidence/kanjidic2-records.xml:52-54). The rich-flavour gloss belongs to whole word 濃厚. Not declared; none needed.

Harmless: 幸 concerns happiness and being fortunate (repo/kanji/幸.md:20-22), not material plenty; no 裕 source gives happiness or luck (evidence/external-snapshots/01-extract.txt:7). Not declared; none needed.

Harmless: 剰's card explicitly defines its excess as more than needed, "not simply a large amount" (repo/kanji/剰.md:23); 裕 is plenty with leeway (evidence/external-snapshots/01-extract.txt:7). Not declared (剰 excludes only 冗); none needed.

Harmless: 充 concerns filling, making sufficient or allotting (repo/kanji/充.md:22-24), an action; its displayed title has no abundance sense and 裕 has no fill/allot sense (evidence/kanjidic2-records.xml:52-54). Not declared; none needed.

Harmless, medium confidence: 悠 is unhurried manner or far extent (repo/kanji/悠.md:23); composure is a whole-word sense of 余裕 (snapshot/words/余裕.md:15), and no opened source gives 裕 alone "leisurely" or "distant". Not declared (悠's list at repo/kanji/悠.md:14 excludes 広 but not 裕); none needed.
Harmless: 金 names the metal, gold and money (repo/kanji/金.md:20); 裕 is the state of having plenty (evidence/kanjidic2-records.xml:52-54), not the substance. Not declared; none needed.

Harmless: 貨 concerns goods, freight, property or currency (repo/kanji/貨.md:20); no abundance or being-rich sense, and 裕 has no goods sense (evidence/kanjidic2-records.xml:52-54). Not declared; none needed.

comparisons.reason: 裕's exclusion relies on 厚's secondary sense "abundant"
comparisons.disposition: Already handled: JMdict gives 厚い a fourth sense "abundant", restricted to the spelling 厚い (evidence/jmdict-families.xml:151-155), and KANJIDIC2 lists "rich" for 厚; 厚's own card teaches only thick and cordial (repo/kanji/厚.md:20). Declared on 裕 (snapshot/kanji/裕.md:14); exclusion justified.
